title: UI polish to premium quality - improve empty/loading/error states, add subtle animations, ensure consistent spacing, verify error handling patterns
description: Polish UI to premium quality: enhance empty/error states with animations, add retry buttons, fix search bar text style, add nav border, reduce jarring animations, verify error handling uses ErrorUtils.sanitize.

findings.environment: Flutter SDK is not installed in the sandbox and network access is restricted. Cannot run flutter analyze or flutter build apk. Changes verified by manual code review only.
changes_summary: home_screen.dart: Enhanced _buildEmptyState with icon container (72x72, rounded), fade-in + scale animation, descriptive subtitle text
home_screen.dart: Enhanced _buildErrorState with error icon container, retry TextButton.icon with styled border, fade-in + scale animation
campaigns_screen.dart: Added GoogleFonts.poppins style (fontSize:14, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface) to search TextField for dark mode visibility
app_bottom_nav.dart: Added Border.all with dividerColor at 0.3 opacity and 0.5px width, only in light mode for premium depth
campaign_card.dart: Reduced slideX begin from 0.05 to 0.02 for subtler entrance animation
apply_screen.dart: Added ErrorUtils import and replaced generic error string with ErrorUtils.sanitize(actionState.error) in the failure SnackBar
verification_notes: checkout_screen.dart: Error SnackBar shows user-friendly message ('Failed to place order. Please try again.') - acceptable since placeOrder() returns bool without exposing error object
withdraw_screen.dart: Already uses ErrorUtils.sanitize(e) correctly in catch block
wallet_screen.dart: AppBar title uses AppTextStyles.h5 (no color set) which correctly inherits from AppBarTheme.titleTextStyle in both modes
admin_app settings_provider.dart: Properly structured with SettingsState, SettingsNotifier, settingsProvider; correctly imported and used in admin_app/app.dart
